O1.reason: P1 is uniform for arbitrary GF2 matrices but has fatal transformed storage/query cost and no native lift; P2/P3 do not supply a target-cheap arbitrary-native compiler.

O2.reason: No surviving implicit producer is integrated into a complete arbitrary-checkpoint load/prefill/decode causal executor.

O3.reason: No arbitrary Q4/BF16/FP32 ordered dense-effect proof is lifted to exact logits, KV/cache, RNG and all successor state for every legal continuation.

O4.reason: All three candidates have finite paid models but their storage, traffic or arithmetic bounds are adverse; no surviving whole-model sufficient upper bound exists.

O5.reason: 405B, CUDA, <=8 GiB target GPU, PCIe/SSD/HBM, same-machine native 4B Q4 p50/p95 and TTFT were not executed.

O6.reason: Preregistration, source, tests, immutable v1/v2/v3 results, checksum and reports are inspectable; complete-theory reproducibility remains open with O1-O5.

established_scoped_results: A finite arbitrary-GF2 direct-query image-frame producer exists whose current query bits directly determine checkpoint-image addresses and which removes about 90% of raw binary source payload in the registered 10/11-bit construction.
The registered P1 construction costs about 4817.82 GiB transformed images and about 4.699 GiB worst simultaneous binary query payload; it is about 8.4357x the registered 8/675 line.

Any complete one-sided linear image frame representing every n-bit right factor with at most t atoms obeys the declared sparse-subset counting lower bound; this does not cover general nonlinear cells.

The value-class ordered-leaf executor is exact in the declared deterministic finite-word ABI, but even one value per column retains about 50% favorable scalar operations and high-distinctness restores 100%.
An exact FP32-integer adversary forces every row to occupy a distinct accumulator/weight transition in every column, so identical-transition state coalescing performs 100% of declared row updates.

Every Boolean-cube bijection preserving coordinatewise AND is a coordinate permutation; even independent invertible linear input/output gauges satisfying C(x AND y)=A(x) AND B(y) are one aligned coordinate permutation.
rejected_scoped_candidates: complete one-sided linear query-image frames as a target-feasible native core
exact duplicate weight-value and identical accumulator/weight transition coalescing as a universal >=90% arithmetic-removal core
safe encoded-state gauges that keep coordinatewise Hadamard/AND cheap while sparsifying an arbitrary dense operator
still_open: general implicit nonlinear finite-word direct-query representation outside the three rejected mechanisms
uniform arbitrary-native compiler/address/read/decode with target-feasible total storage and runtime payload
